description: Use this when the user asks what published research says about a supplement: its overall effects, or whether it does something for a specific health area such as heart health, stress or focus. Also use it when the user asks which supplements have the most research behind them for a health area. Returns SuppCo's summaries of published studies with evidence grades. General information only; does not diagnose, treat or recommend treatment for any condition. For dosing and nutrient basics, use suppco_get_nutrient_info; for a full supplement routine for a goal, use suppco_search_protocols.

health_condition.description: The health area or outcome to look up (e.g., "Heart Health", "Bone & Joint Health", "Focus and Attention"). Optional - omit to get all research for a supplement.

supplement_name.description: The supplement name (e.g., "Fish Oil", "Magnesium"). Optional - omit to search for all supplements related to the condition.

name: suppco_search_effects
title: Search supplement effects
